model.title: Hershel ‘Woody' Williams National Medal of Honor Monument Location Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. James Justice (R-WV)

summary.text: The bill would authorize the National Medal of Honor Museum Foundation to build a commemorative monument on the National Mall honoring Medal of Honor recipients for their acts of valor and sacrifice. The monument would be required to be located within the central area of the National Mall, between the Capitol and Lincoln Memorial.
